correctness.rationale: Removing the closed neighborhood of each acceptance leaves a uniformly ordered admissible set. After fixing 0000 first, second-acceptance distances 2, 3, 4 have weights 6/11, 4/11, 1/11. The first residual graph is a square with two leaves at each of two opposite corners, giving conditional masses 1/12, 4/15, 13/20 at sizes 4, 5, 8; the second is C6, giving masses 1/3 and 2/3 at sizes 4 and 5; the third has six isolated vertices. Mixing recovers the stated law and mean. The mixed-parity maximal sets are either a singleton plus its four distance-three vertices, or two distance-two pairs of opposite parity; completing either parity class gives the remaining two sets. The exact rational replay confirmed all 42 sets, their three orbits, each individual probability and both expectation normalizations.
residual_risks: The calculation certifies the specified finite Q4 model only, not larger cubes or periodic or infinite lattices in general.
